name: wc3-tester
description: Drive Warcraft III in the background for automated map testing: window control, input, screenshots, lifecycle and crash analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Automated Warcraft III map testing from an agent.
interface.longDescription: wc3-tester is an MCP server that launches, attaches to, observes and drives Warcraft III (classic 1.26-1.31 and Reforged 1.32+) while it runs in the background. It provides background window messages and foreground input, screenshots that work on covered windows, and lifecycle/crash reporting including WC3 error logs, WER reports and minidumps.
defaultPrompt: Launch my map and check it loads without crashing
